consumer: game::handle_action's ACTION_RELOAD_WIELDED dispatch calling avatar_action::reload_wielded(): it PERFORMS the reload as a registered player action, asking 'run the avatar's real reload of the wielded gun'
scope: the character's own carried/reachable ammo as the engine's reload_wielded routine itself considers it (not just a snapshot of carried_items)
decisive_source: src/handle_action.cpp::game::handle_action(ACTION_RELOAD_WIELDED) whose body dispatches the registered reload action to avatar_action::reload_wielded(), running the engine's own reload; the carried_items/scalar writers (arcopolis_export.cpp) are display snapshots, not the authority for performing the action
divergence: a gun whose ammo is ambiguous (two compatible ammos) or has NO compatible ammo: a shortcut that directly mutates item.charges so the gun reads loaded would wrongly succeed, whereas the real reload_wielded path would raise a selection menu (ambiguous) or refuse (none) and not silently load it
